V552/V552J/V553 structural-pressure and temporal functions are downstream obligations whose required inputs must survive the cut; they are not automatically candidate-owned measured work.
The exact first common output identity and current generic execution owner/path remain crosswalk questions for B01/B02/B03 rather than grounds for a new architecture.
